summary.en-GB: An add-on that intercepts links that create new Google Calendar events and turns them into iCalendar (ICS) files you can import in your favorite calendar application (Thunderbird, Outlook, Proton Calendar, etc.)

release_notes.en-GB: Updated dependency ical-generator, which had a bug for events created before year 1000. This release also removes source files that were unintentionally bundled into the add-on, shaving at least a dozen of kilobytes.
